description: The Inbox: what's waiting on the person, from every host the app sees. First the asks tasks and chats' models have raised, newest first, each a card expanded in place but cut a few lines down, its form and buttons always shown; then Pending requests (chats waiting on a permission) and Running (chats at a turn). Full width.
opens: the Inbox row over Search sessions
back / forward in the tab history

phone.does: A screen of its own opened from home's Inbox row, titled Inbox with a back arrow; the same content in one column
phone.why: One column at a time on a phone

parts.name: Ask cards
parts.shows: One card per ask (no heading over them), newest first, as wide as the tab with the chat's side gutters.

phone.does: The list sits on the frame (baude.frame, the grey behind the side panel's Tasks, Subagents and Side questions pages) and each ask is an inset card in the inside colour (baude.inside, as Hosts' groups are), its cut fading into that colour
phone.why: The owner asked for the side panel pages' grey under the Inbox and the dark inset under each message

decisions.said: Also on mobile, inbox should sit on a gray background (similar to tasks, subagents, isde questisons .etc) and the messages themselves should have the dark inset background.
decisions.rule: Every app's Inbox on a phone puts its list on the frame colour its side panel pages use and draws each ask as a card in the inside colour, with no card colour of its own.

parts.name: Head
parts.shows: The ask's title (bold, one line, fading out where it's cut), then at its end the time it was raised (dim: HH:MM today, else the weekday and time, else the date) and the yellow waiting dot.

actions.does: Opens the ask in a tab of its own (InboxAsk.page.json).

parts.name: Body
parts.shows: The ask as InboxAsk.page.json draws it (from line and ⋯, its Markdown, pictures), cut a few lines down (160 px) with a fade into the card's colour and "Show more" under it when it's taller; "Show more" shows it whole and becomes "Show less". A short ask isn't cut and has no "Show more".

parts.name: Form and buttons
parts.shows: Never cut: the ask's form (setting rows) and its buttons with Route to…, as the ask opened has them, working the same way.

parts.name: Stopped ask
parts.shows: An ask whose task went away (its run ended, or its host restarted) unanswered, or a chat's own ask whose chat was archived or deleted: its card greyed, its title and heading struck through, "Not answered — the task stopped" (a chat's: "Not answered — the chat was archived or deleted") (dim) in place of the time and dot, its form and buttons off. ⋯ → Remove takes it out of every Inbox.

parts.name: Pending requests
parts.shows: A group heading, then one row per chat waiting on a permission, drawn as the sidebar's rows (the Bot's picture or the chat's title, the yellow dot) with a tag saying what it asks ("Allow Bash?"). Left out when there are none.

actions.does: Opens that chat, as the sidebar does.

parts.name: Running
parts.shows: A group heading, then one row per chat at a turn, drawn as the sidebar's rows with the grey pulsing dot. Left out when there are none.

states.name: empty
states.shows: "Nothing is waiting on you", dim, centred.

states.name: an ask answered on another device
states.shows: Its card leaves the list at once: the host tells every head (inbox_changed).

removed.name: Asks heading
removed.why: The owner: no "Asks" header on the list.

removed.name: Collapse all / Expand all
removed.why: Went with the Asks heading row; the owner chose each ask expanded and cut with Show more (example-6b).

decisions.said: The Inbox gathers all running sessions, all pending requests and every ask a task has of the person.
decisions.rule: Every app's Inbox lists the asks, then Pending requests, then Running.

decisions.said: A preview of the list with each ask expanded in place may be useful.
decisions.rule: Every app shows each ask in the list in place, not as a collapsed row.

decisions.said: The list preview is B: each ask expanded, cut with Show more (example-6b).
decisions.rule: Every app cuts a long ask a few lines down with a fade and Show more; its form and buttons are never cut.
No app puts a heading over the asks.

decisions.said: Asks persist across a restart, shown as cancelled / unanswered when their task went away; a cancelled ask is shown struck through with "Not answered — the task stopped", in the list and opened (example-7b, example-7e).
decisions.rule: Every app keeps an ask whose task went away, struck through and greyed with "Not answered — the task stopped", its buttons off.

decisions.said: Asks are answered once: one answered anywhere leaves every Inbox.
decisions.rule: Every app drops an ask from its Inbox as its host says it's answered or withdrawn, whichever device answered it.

decisions.said: A model should be able to ask the user stuff in a formatted task like manners without a task to begin with i.e. direct access to the human ask machinery and the artefact builder
decisions.rule: Every app's Inbox lists the asks chats' models raise themselves (no task) with the tasks' asks, newest first, each from its chat.
